title: The Flower That Sent a Message
intro: This quiz follows Mira and Jonah as they learn how pollination helps plants make seeds and how seeds travel to new places.

questions.prompt: What powder do flowers produce that can help them make seeds?
questions.explanation: Flowers produce pollen, which can help them make seeds.

questions.prompt: How did the bee help pollinate the flowers?
choices: It carried pollen from one flower to another
It planted seeds in the soil
It protected the flowers from wind
questions.explanation: The bee helped pollinate the flowers by carrying pollen from one flower to another.

questions.prompt: Which of these can move pollen between flowers?
choices: Bees, butterflies, birds, bats, and wind
questions.explanation: Bees, butterflies, birds, bats, and wind can move pollen between flowers.

choices: It keeps every seed beside the parent plant
It helps seeds find space, sunlight, water, and soil to grow
questions.explanation: Seed dispersal helps seeds find space, sunlight, water, and soil to grow.

questions.prompt: Which is an example of seed dispersal by animals?
choices: Dandelion seeds blowing in the wind
Burrs sticking to fur or clothing
questions.explanation: Burrs sticking to fur or clothing is an example of seed dispersal by animals.
